_about: Curated business meanings for the NorthWind PLUS model, taken from the comments in NorthWind_PLUS_Graph_Data_Model_Import_v2.3.2.cypher and the Python harness. The loader merges these with the GRAPH TYPE (exact names, types, keys) and the RDF/Turtle ontology (Entity vs Collection, rdfs:comment). Edit this file to teach the agent more about the business.
model_principles: State lives in relationships, not properties: an entity's current state is which Collection (hub) node points at it, e.g. (:NewPoS)-[:IS_NEW_PO_STATE]->(:PurchaseOrder).
Collection labels end with a capital letter (PoS, NewPoS, OrderStatusOpeN). Singleton collections are matched by Name or Status, e.g. (:NewPoS {Name:"NewPoS"}), (:OrderStatusOpeN {Status:"Open"}).
Moving an entity to a new state = create the new IS_*_STATE edge and delete the old one. Nodes are never deleted.

Only three properties are updated in place (isotope nodes): InventoryLevel.UnitsInStock, OrderLevel.UnitsOnOrder, ReorderLevel.StockThreshold. RolE approval values change only through the governed Approval Policy Change.
PO cost = SUM(HAS_PO_ITEM.POqt * Product.UnitPrice * HAS_PO_ITEM.POPriceDiscount). Approval bands: RolE {Title:'Level1Approver'|'Level2Approver'|'Level3Approver'}.ApprovalBase/ApprovalLimit.
Order line values live on the relationship: HAS_ORDER_PRODUCT {Quantity, UnitPrice, Discount}. PO lines: HAS_PO_ITEM {POqt, POPriceDiscount}. RFQ lines: HAS_RFQ_ITEM {RFQqt, RFQcost}.
Employees reach their name through (:Employee)-[:HAS_PERSON]->(:Person {FirstName, LastName}) and their job through (:RolE {Title})-[:IS_ACTIVE_ROLE]->(:Employee).
Dates are ZONED DATETIME. ShipInfo.ShippedDate uses 9999-12-31 as a sentinel for never-shipped imported Orders; order state still comes from relationships.

node_types.Product: A product Northwind sells. Stock, on-order and reorder levels are separate isotope nodes; availability is a Collection (ProductStatusAvailablE / ProductStatusDiscontinueD).
node_types.ProductCategorY: A product category (Beverages, Condiments, ...). Points to its Products via IS_PRODUCT_CATEGORY_OF.
node_types.Supplier: A company that supplies Products and receives Purchase Orders. Has its own PO collections (SupplierNewPoS, SupplierOpenPoS, SupplierClosedPoS) so it sees only its own POs.
node_types.Customer: A company that places Customer Orders.
node_types.Employee: A Northwind employee. Name via HAS_PERSON -> Person; job title via RolE -[:IS_ACTIVE_ROLE]->.
node_types.Person: Personal details (FirstName, LastName, ...) of an Employee.
node_types.RolE: A job title (Sales Representative, Procurement Assistant, Level1Approver, Level2Approver, Level3Approver, Buyer, WarehouseClerk, Finance, ProcurementPolicyAdmin, ...). Level1/2/3Approver carry ApprovalBase/ApprovalLimit, the PO approval bands.
node_types.Territory: A sales territory; HAS_EMPLOYEE points to the Employees covering it.
node_types.Shipper: A shipping company used for Customer Order shipments.
node_types.Order: A Customer Order. Lines are HAS_ORDER_PRODUCT relationships to Products. State: OrderStatusOpeN or OrderStatusFulfilleD points at it.
node_types.PurchaseOrder: A Purchase Order (PO) to a Supplier, created when Products run low. Moves through NewPoS -> (L1/L2/L3 vetting) -> ApprovedPoS or RejectedPoS -> SubmittedPoS (Buyer sends it to the Supplier) -> ClosedPoS (delivered and paid).
node_types.RFQ: A Supplier's quote (Request For Quotation reply) for a submitted PO. The Buyer approves it (HAS_APPROVED_RFQ from the PO) or rejects it (PoRejectedRFQ); a rejected RFQ can be resubmitted (HAS_PREVIOUS_RFQ).
node_types.Address: A postal address (Supplier, Customer, Person home, or Order shipment).
node_types.Contact: Contact details for a Supplier or Customer.
node_types.ShipInfo: Shipment details of a Customer Order (shipper, date, freight, address).
node_types.InventoryLevel: Isotope node: current UnitsInStock of one Product. Updated by Warehouse delivery (+) and Order fulfillment (-).
node_types.OrderLevel: Isotope node: UnitsOnOrder of one Product -- quantity confirmed by approved RFQs and not yet delivered.
node_types.ReorderLevel: Isotope node: StockThreshold of one Product. PO Creation triggers when effective stock falls near this threshold.
node_types.PolicyChange: Audit record of one change to the L1/L2/L3 approval bands: before/after limits, justification, date, who requested it (REQUESTED_BY) and which roles changed (CHANGED_ROLE).
node_types.ProductStatusAvailablE: Collection: Products currently available for sale (Status:'Available').
node_types.OrderS: Superset collection of Customer Order states (Open, Fulfilled, Canceled).
node_types.OrderStatusOpeN: Collection: Customer Orders not yet shipped (Status:'Open').
node_types.OrderStatusFulfilleD: Collection: Customer Orders shipped (Status:'Fulfilled'). The IS_FULFILLED_ORDER_STATE edge carries FulfillDate.
node_types.OrderStatusCanceleD: Collection: canceled Customer Orders (declared, not used yet).
node_types.SupplierS: Superset collection of Supplier vetting states.
node_types.PendingSupplierS: Collection: Suppliers pending approval (declared, not used yet).
node_types.RejectedSupplierS: Collection: rejected Suppliers (declared, not used yet).
node_types.PoS: Superset collection of PO states (NewPoS, ApprovedPoS, RejectedPoS, SubmittedPoS, ClosedPoS).
node_types.ApprovedPoS: Collection: POs fully approved, waiting for the Buyer to submit them to the Supplier.
node_types.RejectedPoS: Collection: POs rejected at L1, L2 or L3. A rejected PO can be resubmitted as a new PO pointing back with HAS_PREVIOUS_PO.
node_types.SubmittedPoS: Collection: POs submitted to the Supplier; they stay here through RFQ, delivery and payment until closed.
node_types.ClosedPoS: Collection: POs delivered, paid and closed by Finance.
node_types.SupplierNewPoS: Per-Supplier collection: new POs the Supplier has not quoted yet. Answers the Supplier's question 'Do I have any new POs?'.
node_types.SupplierOpenPoS: Per-Supplier collection: POs the Supplier has quoted and must still follow up or deliver.
node_types.SupplierClosedPoS: Per-Supplier collection: the Supplier's closed POs.
node_types.PoNewRFQ: Per-PO collection: RFQs received for this PO and awaiting Buyer vetting.
node_types.PoRejectedRFQ: Per-PO collection: RFQs the Buyer rejected for this PO.

rel_types.IS_NEW_PO_STATE: The PO is awaiting approval vetting.
rel_types.IS_APPROVED_PO_STATE: The PO was fully approved (Date) and waits for the Buyer to submit it.
rel_types.IS_SUBMITTED_PO_STATE: The Buyer submitted the PO to its Supplier (Date).
rel_types.IS_CLOSED_PO_STATE: The PO was paid and closed by Finance (Date, Comment).
rel_types.HAS_PO_ITEM: A PO line: POqt units of the Product at POPriceDiscount (fraction of UnitPrice, e.g. 0.7).
rel_types.PO_FOR_SUPPLIER: The Supplier the PO is addressed to.
rel_types.PO_CREATED_BY: The Procurement Assistant who created the PO.
rel_types.HAS_PREVIOUS_PO: This PO resubmits an earlier rejected PO (Resubmission_Justification). Chains show the full rejection/resubmission lineage.
rel_types.HAS_L1_PO_APPROVAL: Level 1 approved the PO (final if cost < L1 limit, otherwise passed up to L2).
rel_types.HAS_L2_PO_APPROVAL: Level 2 approved the PO (final if cost < L2 limit, otherwise passed up to L3).
rel_types.HAS_BUYER_PO_APPROVAL: The Buyer approved and submitted the PO to the Supplier.
rel_types.HAS_WAREHOUSE_DELIVERY: A Warehouse Clerk received the PO's products and updated inventory.
rel_types.IS_SUPPLIER_NEW_PO_STATE: The PO is new for the Supplier (not yet quoted).
rel_types.IS_SUPPLIER_OPEN_PO_STATE: The Supplier has quoted the PO and must follow up / deliver.
rel_types.HAS_SUPPLIER_CLOSED_PO_STATE: The PO is closed from the Supplier's side (naming exception: siblings are IS_SUPPLIER_*).
rel_types.RFQ_FROM_SUPPLIER: The Supplier that sent the RFQ.
rel_types.HAS_RFQ_ITEM: An RFQ line: RFQqt units at RFQcost per unit.
rel_types.HAS_PREVIOUS_RFQ: This RFQ resubmits an earlier rejected RFQ (Justification).
rel_types.HAS_APPROVED_RFQ: The PO's accepted RFQ (Date). Units then count as UnitsOnOrder until delivered.
rel_types.HAS_ORDER_PRODUCT: A Customer Order line: Quantity of the Product at UnitPrice with Discount (fraction).
rel_types.HAS_ORDER_CUSTOMER: The Customer who placed the Order.
rel_types.SOLD_BY: The Sales Representative who sold the Order.
rel_types.IS_OPEN_ORDER_STATE: The Customer Order is open (not shipped).
rel_types.HAS_WAREHOUSE_FULFILLMENT: The Warehouse Clerk who picked, packed and shipped the Order (Date).
rel_types.IS_ACTIVE_ROLE: The Employee currently holds this job title (StartDate; EndDate when it ended).
rel_types.IS_AVAILABLE_PRODUCT: The Product is available for sale.
rel_types.RATED: Recommendation layer: Customer's purchase-frequency rating of a Product (Rating, 0-1).
rel_types.SIMILARITY: Recommendation layer: cosine similarity between two Customers' ratings (Similarity).
rel_types.REQUESTED_BY: The Employee who requested the approval-policy change.
rel_types.CHANGED_ROLE: An approver role whose band this policy change modified.

Customer Ordering.description: Customers place Orders with 1-11 product lines; new Orders start Open.

Order Fulfillment.description: A Warehouse Clerk ships the oldest Open Order whose every line has stock, decrementing inventory.

Inventory & Reorder.description: Stock, units on order and reorder thresholds per Product; low effective stock triggers PO Creation.

PO Creation.description: A Procurement Assistant creates one PO per Supplier whose Products fall near the reorder threshold.

PO Vetting.description: L1/L2/L3 approvers approve, pass up or reject POs by cost band; rejected POs can be resubmitted.

RFQ.description: The Buyer submits approved POs to Suppliers, Suppliers reply with RFQs, the Buyer approves, rejects or receives resubmissions.

Warehouse & Finance.description: The Warehouse receives a PO's products (stock up, on-order down); Finance pays and closes the PO.

Approval Policy.description: A ProcurementPolicyAdmin changes the L1/L2/L3 approval bands; every change is a PolicyChange record.

Sales Analytics.description: Sales by employee, region, territory, category and customer.

Recommendations.description: Collaborative filtering: Customer ratings and Customer similarity.

Data Quality.description: Consistency checks run during or after the simulation: things that should never happen (double states, negative stock, gaps between approval bands).

Graph Statistics.description: Structural facts about the graph: schema, node/edge ratio, most-connected nodes.
